description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultRecentSearchRepository class, which manages recent search queries in the app. It interacts with a DAO to insert, retrieve, and clear recent searches, facilitating data persistence and retrieval for the recent search feature.

classes.name: DefaultRecentSearchRepository
classes.description: Implementation of RecentSearchRepository that uses a DAO to perform database operations related to recent search queries.

methods.name: insertOrReplaceRecentSearch
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a recent search query with the specified search string and current timestamp.

methods.name: getRecentSearchQueries
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of recent search queries limited to the specified number.

methods.name: clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears all stored recent search queries from the database.
